evidenceLimits: The native remote owner remains outside the active world with its original enabled descriptor and inactive buff collection. No lifecycle flag or effect activation changes.
Real native buff rows preserve native titles, icons, timers, dimming and an ordinary Bless control; this does not qualify active effects or combat mechanics.
The native Show animation finishes at alpha 1 for these inactive rows. The fixture preserves the observed alpha and does not impose different dimming.
Twelve native disposable mercenaries complete the existing creator regression; exact original membership/items/money/pause restored and no save writes.

Final native TMP glyph meshes, actual clipping-mask containment, separation from every other visible buff row and icon/timer, and exact character sequences are validated. Raw Overflow flags and nominal label/row rectangle containment remain explicit diagnostics; no title/font/layout is changed.
Other capture stages on this DLL retain provenance; earlier UI qualifications remain separately labeled artifacts.
Eighty production images and final native UI still await owner approval.
diagnostics: Build 1 passed tests but failed exact compilation on a missing namespace; no deployment.
Build 2 first Ifrit failed before buff insertion; immediate sheet cleanup masked the original exception. Original installation restored.
Build 3 diagnostic Ifrit identified an overstrict descriptor-off guard; native remote descriptors stay on while buff collections are inactive. Original installation restored.
The corrected guard preserves that observed descriptor state and retains the native inactive-collection requirement.

Build 4 proved exact inactive additions and restoration but encountered a cached empty native buff section. Build 5 calls the native SetDirty before Refresh, uses actual section membership and records native rows before capture.

Build 5 Ifrit passed 13 assertions / 102 captures; Oread failed normalized-scroll restoration after its third target capture. Owned buffs/world/creator state and installation restored; remaining races did not launch.

Build 6 uses explicit read-only observation for already-visible buff rows, with no scroll writes and the existing actual-position tolerance, velocity/axis and bounds checks. Oread records confirm the normalized getter can flip 1 to 0 on approximately 0.00003 layout-unit rounding while actual geometry is retained. Existing reveal-and-restore callers keep their behavior.

Build 6 Oread and Ifrit passed. Sylph failed the raw TMP overflow flag for the visibly complete two-line Winds Calmed title. Buff/world cleanup succeeded, but the overall run failed before creator completion; Undine/smoke did not launch. Original installation restored.
Owner-requested master e5f1426a was integrated and independently qualified as a20b0d23, preserving the buff WIP. Build 7 resumes on version 0.0.129.

Build 7 replaces the insufficient raw-overflow gate with observations of the complete final native mesh and independently validates actual row/mask containment and icon/timer separation. Missing, nonfinite, clipped, culled, truncated or overlapping glyphs fail; overflow remains reported.

The first build 7 Sylph run passed all three buff mesh observations and its buff assertion, then failed an atomic JSON evidence File.Replace with a Windows sharing violation during live-file status reads. It finished 11/13 assertions, two complete creators and full original cleanup; no save writes. Subsequent matrix monitoring reads each final evidence set only after the game exits. No compiled source or artifact changed for the retry.

Build 7 retry passed Sylph/Oread/Ifrit. Undine failed because Nereid Fascination Aura final mesh exceeded its unmasked layout row by 0.214111 units while all glyphs were generated inside the actual mask and clear of its icon/timer. Buff/world and seven creator cleanup checks passed; early-exception service animation was not fully closed at observation. Overall FAIL, normal exit, no save writes; original 136 files restored. Smoke did not launch.

Build 8 treats nominal unmasked row containment as diagnostic and requires every actual clipping mask and separation from every neighboring visible buff row. No arbitrary geometry tolerance increase or native text/layout edit. One new focused corruption test adds omitted masks/rows, neighbor overlap, nonfinite geometry and false containment checks. All four races and smoke must pass this new artifact.
